question: Does the official indexed text for the 2018 SNMC EPRMP preserve enough of Table 2-15 to record the reported fish-by-station marks and reconcile its internal counts?

sourceDocument.title: Environmental Performance Report and Management Plan: SNMC Quarry Expansion & 1.5 MMTPY Limestone Pulverizing Plant
sourceDocument.publisherAsReported: Solid North Mineral Corporation; hosted by the DENR Environmental Management Bureau EIA portal
sourceDocument.indexedPdfLineLocator: The official PDF text extraction exposed the Freshwater Ecology section and Table 2-15. The follow-up checked lines 4282-4453 of the web-indexed extraction on 2026-11-24; these are not printed page line numbers.

accessReview.officialIndexedText: Accessible in the web search/open index and re-read for Table 2-15 row labels and X marks.
accessReview.directPdfAndScreenshot: The PDF screenshot request returned HTTP 403. The source PDF page was not visually inspected, and no challenge or access control was bypassed.
accessReview.tableCellConfidence: provisional text-derived transcription; not visually verified
accessReview.reuseTerms: No item-specific open license or permission to redistribute this report-derived table was verified.

reportedMethodAndLimits.methodAsPrinted: The EPRMP says fish and invertebrate identifications were based on actual identification and interviews with people around the river, but does not identify the evidence mode for each taxon or station.
reportedMethodAndLimits.tableHeadingAsPrinted: Updated Fish Species Found in the 6 Sampling Stations
reportedMethodAndLimits.meaningOfX: An X is transcribed only as a source-reported table mark. It is not independently verified as a captured or observed specimen.
reportedMethodAndLimits.blankCellInterpretation: A blank is not evidence of absence; the report does not give per-station effort, detection protocol, or taxon-specific evidence mode.

internalCountCrosscheck.assessment: The station-5 and station-6 totals match the sum of the text-derived fish and non-fish row marks. This supports the parsing order but does not verify the rendered table, field identifications, survey completeness, or current presence. The surrounding prose still names only seven fish rows while the table contains ten.

taxonomyDisposition.note: All ten taxon strings are preserved verbatim. Orthographic variants and historical combinations remain unreviewed; no accepted-name crosswalk or specimen re-identification was performed.

decision: Retain the text-derived station-mark matrix as a provisional historical research transcription only. Do not use X marks as specimen-level occurrences, blanks as absences, or as evidence of current presence, abundance, catchability, legal access, safety, diet, or bait recommendations. Keep the 2006 survey distinct from the May 2022 Conlong/Salapangan assessment. No app-facing data is admitted.
nextActions: Obtain a lawfully accessible rendered copy or authorized underlying field records before treating station marks as verified; the current PDF screenshot route returned 403.
Cross-check all ten verbatim labels against a pinned authoritative fish taxonomy and seek taxon-specific vouchers or field-identification notes before normalization.
Keep the six printed station labels distinct until an independently sourced watercourse/name crosswalk and suitable spatial evidence are reviewed.
Check item-specific reuse terms before distributing any report-derived table or app content.

sources.supports: Official EMB-hosted 2018 EPRMP indexed text for the 2006 survey year, six station labels, Table 2-15 fish-row labels and X marks, surrounding fish-count wording, and the station 5/6 totals. The page image could not be verified because the screenshot request returned HTTP 403.
